name: Pavé de Genève chocolate
about: A soft, square ganache chocolate named after Geneva. It is a classic local gift that Swiss confectioners have made for generations.
tip: Check the best-before date, because fresh chocolate has a short shelf life.

name: Swiss watch
where: Boutiques on Rue du Rhône and Swatch stores
about: Geneva is the heart of Swiss watchmaking, with many brands based here. Watches range from affordable Swatch models to high-end pieces.
tip: Swatch starts around 100 and Tissot around 300, so compare prices before you buy.
